How do I use it properly the very first time?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
Great question! Here's how to set up and use your new Eco Organic Mattress:
Unboxing (First 30 Minutes)
Open your mattress within 30 days of delivery to ensure proper expansion and warranty validity
Unbox it in the room where you'll use it — these organic mattresses can be heavier than expected
Remove the outer wrap, then place the still-sealed mattress on your bed frame or foundation
Cut the inner vacuum seal and watch it expand — you can sleep on it within about 30 minutes, though full expansion takes 3-5 hours
What to Expect
You'll notice a fresh, natural scent (not chemical off-gassing) that will dissipate quickly
The mattress is safe to sleep on immediately, even if it continues settling over 24-48 hours
The Break-In Period (Important!)
Here's the key thing beginners need to know: the wool and cotton layers will soften and compress naturally over the first 30-60 days. The mattress you sleep on tonight won't feel the same in six weeks — it gets better as it breaks in.
Your body may also need time to adjust to proper support, which can cause a few aches initially. That's why the Eco Organic has a 100-night sleep trial with a required 30-day minimum adjustment period.
